5022997.sourceDescription: Transform any room into a festive haven with this 6ft pop up Christmas tree. Its slim profile makes it ideal for tighter spaces, hallways or anywhere you want seasonal charm without taking over the whole floor. bjr08cvv.variantName: Walplus 564 Branch Tips Artificial Christmas Tree - White - 180 cm
bjr08cvv.sourceDescription: This stunningly dense Christmas tree with 620 branch tips looks as if it is covered in a heavy blanket of snow. This pure, white Christmas tree will form the striking centrepiece of your Christmas decorations. Made of quality PVC material, it looks like a real Christmas tree. The Christmas tree can be used again every year, making it a very economical choice compared to a real tree. It can only be used indoors. The Christmas tree is easy to assemble, thanks to its simple plug-in system. Create a unique Christmas atmosphere in your home! Delivery also includes a stable plastic stand. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Whether for Christmas gatherings or as a seasonal centerpiece, this tree provides a stylish and refined look that evokes simple traditions and modern aesthetics. Solid Teak Wood Construction This Christmas tree is crafted from high-quality solid teak wood, known for its remarkable durability and striking appearance. The wood's inherent strength and resistance to wear make it a lasting seasonal piece, retaining its beauty through many holiday seasons. Its warm, earthy tones harmoniously blend with various decor styles, making it a versatile addition to any living space. Easy Setup Thanks to its smart design, setting up this tree is a straightforward process that saves time during the hectic holiday period. The assembly requires only a screwdriver and two people, ensuring structural stability while taking out the stress of complex setups and allowing you to focus on decorating. Durable Build With a focus on longevity, this Christmas tree boasts a robust design that withstands the test of time. Use it year after year without signs of wear, enjoying a worry-free festive atmosphere filled with holiday cheer. Its durability not only contributes to its aesthetic appeal but also offers benefits through repeated use. Versatile Indoor Placement Perfect for indoor settings, whether nestled in your living room or enhancing your hallway decor. Its rustic design complements both modern and traditional interiors, serving as a beautiful focal point that invites holiday joy and liveliness into your home. Minimal Maintenance Maintaining this Christmas tree is straightforward; simply wipe with a dry cloth to keep it clean and in pristine condition. This easy-care method ensures your tree remains a beloved centerpiece for family moments and festive gatherings.
